2018.notes: 1% residents, 0.5% nonresidents, $750 per exemption (2018 CF-1040 forms and instructions, Wayback copy from the city site). The tax began January 1, 2018.

2019.notes: 1% residents, 0.5% nonresidents, $750 per exemption (2019 CF-1040 forms and instructions, Wayback copy from the city site).

2020.notes: 1% residents, 0.5% nonresidents, $750 per exemption (2020 CF-1040 forms and instructions, Wayback copy from the city site).

2021.notes: 1% residents, 0.5% nonresidents, $750 per exemption (2021 CF-1040 forms and instructions, Wayback copy from the city site).

2022.notes: 1% residents, 0.5% nonresidents: the rate fixed by the Uniform City Income Tax Ordinance (MCL 141.611) for a city that has not adopted a higher rate under MCL 141.503a; the city's 2021 and 2023 CF-1040 instructions both give 1% / 0.5% and $750 per exemption, and no 2022 instructions were located online.

2023.notes: 1% residents, 0.5% nonresidents (city Income Tax Department page; 2023 CF-1040 forms are published at https://www.bhcity.us/pview.aspx?id=55090&catid=292). The tax began January 1, 2018; no city document for 2018-2022 was located.
